phase2a.recommendation: Variant D (gated policy) beat the legacy policy on return without added drawdown in this run. Consider promoting D after reviewing per-window stability — promotion is a manual decision, nothing is auto-deployed.
phase2a.deployment_note: ANALYSIS ONLY. The live decision pipeline still uses the legacy policy (variant C). Deploying the gated policy requires an explicit, separate change.

strategy_audit.methodology: Every strategy was audited on ALL of its raw entry signals across the full universe (no ranking, no portfolio caps, no confidence filter), each filled at the next day's open with a fixed ₹100,000 notional and realistic costs. Exit alternatives and holding buckets were re-simulated on IDENTICAL entries. Variant and holding selection used TRAINING windows only; all tables below show unseen TEST-window results. Failed variants and negative results are preserved.

loss_attribution.name: EMA Cross
findings: Gap risk: 7 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (5% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: MACD Cross
findings: A break-even stop after +1×ATR (G) improves expectancy — winners are being allowed to turn back into losers.
Gap risk: 4 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (2% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Mean Reversion
findings: 63% of trades hit the stop, but wider stops do NOT help — losses come from entry selection, not stop placement.
Gap risk: 27 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (6% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Trend Rider
findings: Stop-loss appears TOO TIGHT: 46% of trades stop out, and wider/trailing stops (alternatives B/C) improve expectancy.
Gap risk: 57 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (6% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Breakout Hunter
findings: Target appears TOO AMBITIOUS: only 0% of trades reach it, and removing the target (signal-only exit D) improves expectancy.
A break-even stop after +1×ATR (G) improves expectancy — winners are being allowed to turn back into losers.
Gap risk: 4 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (9% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Supertrend
findings: Time exits dominate (33%) and a shorter fixed 10-day horizon (E) does better — signal exits fire too late.
A break-even stop after +1×ATR (G) improves expectancy — winners are being allowed to turn back into losers.
Gap risk: 2 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (2% of trades).

macd_optimization.methodology: Every enhancement was tested INDEPENDENTLY on MACD Cross only. Entry filters and exit parameters were selected on each window's TRAINING data and then applied unchanged to the unseen TEST window; risk rules are fixed (untuned) portfolio-level policies replayed over the test windows. Entry filters only remove baseline entries. Trade-level tables use a fixed ₹100,000 notional per trade; portfolio tables start each window at ₹50,000 and chain across windows. Rejected enhancements are preserved with reasons.

Confirmation requires fresh data the optimizer has never seen (continued paper trading).
